artists.biography:
Baxter Dury (born 18 December 1971, Wingrave, Buckinghamshire, England) is an English indie musician, currently signed to Rough Trade Records. He is the son of Ian Dury, and as a five-year-old he appeared on the front cover of Ian's LP New Boots and Panties!!. He left school at the age of fourteen. He has had a 'Record of the Week' in NME with Oscar Brown EP in 2002. He has one son, Kosmo Korda Dury (born 2002) whose mother is the granddaughter of Zoltan Korda.
More recently, Dury has signed a new recording contract with Parlophone.

perplexity.description:
Allbarone, released on September 12, 2025, is the tenth studio album by English musician Baxter Dury, issued through Heavenly Recordings and [PIAS]. Produced by Paul Epworth, known for his work with Adele and Florence & The Machine, the album marks a significant collaboration after a five-year hiatus for Epworth. Musically, Allbarone blends electronic and rock elements with a futuristic, stripped-down sound that departs from traditional band arrangements, aiming for a fresh and contemporary feel. The album's nine tracks feature sardonic storytelling and a character-driven narrative exploring social archetypes with sharp wit and humor, enhanced by guest vocals from JGrrey on several songs.

Within Baxter Dury's discography, Allbarone is seen as a compelling evolution, following his 2023 album I Thought I Was Better Than You and continuing the fruitful partnership with Epworth that revitalized his sound on 2020’s The Night Chancers. Critics have praised Allbarone for its cohesiveness and raw authenticity, with Record Collector calling it his most compelling work since Prince of Tears (2017), and The Quietus highlighting it as the "rawest and truest manifestation" of Dury’s artistry to date. Commercially, the album debuted at number 93 on the UK Albums Chart, performing notably better on the Scottish and UK Independent Albums Charts, reaching numbers 10 and 2 respectively.

The album’s style incorporates hyperpop influences while maintaining Dury’s signature sardonic lyricism and storytelling, pushing his music into new experimental and futuristic pop territories. Tracks like “Kublah Khan” showcase a mix of hip-hop, funk, and jungle sounds, underscoring the album’s diverse sonic palette. This blend of electronic textures with rock sensibilities and Dury’s distinctive narrative voice positions Allbarone as a forward-looking yet deeply personal record within his body of work.
